observations: The migration grants settings.contract and manageClinicalTechnicalResponsibility to administrative functions while keeping adipometryProtocolApproval false.
The lifecycle control creates administrative and sibling non-administrative functions after migrations, checks deny-by-default behavior, and reruns the exact migration without duplicate grants.

The HTTP control authenticates a professor assigned to the administrative function, requires PUT /contracts/adipometry-governance/responsible to succeed and persist, and requires protocol approval to return 403.
The remediation gate invokes both lifecycle and HTTP controls on the material candidate; Validate PR run 7103 completed successfully for this SHA.
